methodological_rules_for_ml: The same frozen main split must be used for BIO, NETWORK, and BIO+NETWORK comparisons.
All imputation, scaling, log transforms, encoding, and any other fitted preprocessing must be learned from training data only.
Validation data may be used for model/hyperparameter selection; the test set must remain untouched until the final evaluation.
For hemisphere robustness, side must be removed from the feature set because it defines the domain split itself.
Center and missing-side neurons remain in the main experiment but are excluded from hemisphere-transfer robustness.
